title: Practicably
summary: PRAC'TICABLY, adverb In such a manner as may be performed. 'A rule practicably applied before his eyes, ' is not correct language. It is probably a mistake for practically.

inlines.v: PRAC'TICABLY, adverb In such a manner as may be performed. 'A rule practicably applied before his eyes, ' is not correct language. It is probably a mistake for practically.
